selection_basis: Follow-up development selection after the first prototype failed a broader output audit. Spatial verifier v4, crop gate 0.9, path evidence floor 0.15, and elongated-color rejection retain 17/18 diagnostic positive samples and repeat none of nine diagnosed errors; old development frame check 13/16 correct with zero wrong outputs. Same known-positive recall as less conservative gate 0.8 with fewer weak outputs. These diagnostics are reused for selection; they are not a final independent test. The nine-point temporal check is now reused, and 23 current-game development positives train the verifier. The 59 cross-game regression labels remain out of training and were not scored for verifier selection.
